metadata.title: Stars on the run: escaping from stellar clusters

notes: No eligible stars. The paper's explicit "unbound" condition applies to escape from the model cluster, not the Milky Way: stars are removed after reaching more than four tidal radii with positive total energy (T:p3-b8), and escapers are identified by reaching 100 pc with positive total energy (T:p7-b9). Its "hyper-velocity escapers" are defined by a cluster-relative threshold of 100 km/s (T:p7-b10), not by a Galactic escape criterion. The high-velocity stars considered for halo distances are assessed using cluster-relative velocities and straight-line travel without following the Galactic potential (T:p8-b3, T:p9-b0), so they are not identified as Galactic unbound candidates.
